batch_history.semantic_review: Compared mechanisms and outputs with all preceding IDs and equations and linked the closest existing method. QR is an orthogonal triangular decomposition, pivoted QR exposes numerical rank, and complete orthogonal factorization supplies a minimum-norm solution with a right orthogonal factor. The SVD solve extracts a solution from singular values and vectors, while bidiagonal reduction supplies the intermediate matrix. Reduction of a symmetric pencil uses a positive definite metric, while QZ handles regular general pencils. Rejected LQ as a transpose counterpart of QR and grouped blocked implementations and storage formats under their underlying methods.

batch_history.semantic_review: Compared the existing distribution, regression, inference and scoring records for overlapping mechanisms. The logistic law describes a continuous residual distribution, while logistic regression predicts a Bernoulli class probability. The central chi-square law supplies a reference distribution for statistics such as Breusch–Pagan. Excluded beta prime because rescaling F recovers it, Lomax because generalized Pareto already covers it, and log-logistic because it is the d=1 Burr XII case. Kept Student t as the residual-law family and omitted its Cauchy special case.
